meta.system_name_zh: 中国星官（三垣二十八宿）
meta.system_name_en: Chinese Xingguan (Three Enclosures and Twenty-Eight Mansions)
meta.attribution: Chinese Xingguan names, star assignments and figures from Stellarium's chinese sky culture (CC BY-SA 4.0), based on Yi Xiang Kao Cheng (1756) / its continuation (1844), as compiled in Yi Shitong's Chinese and Western Contrast Star Chart and Catalogue 1950.0.
meta.mapping: Exact HIP -> HYG v4.1 id match (source lists HIP only). HYG proper/Bayer names are recorded for every mapped star. Unmapped HIPs are left empty and counted; no name guess, no memory-based star insertion.
meta.region_scope: Minimal usable set: three enclosures (紫微/太微/天市) and twenty-eight mansions. Each enclosure is represented by its left/right wall figures for drawing; its star membership includes all Xingguans listed under that enclosure in star_names.zh_CN.fab.
meta.boundary_note: 源说明明确：星官只表示恒星分布，没有具体边界（Xingguans refer only to the way stars are distributed, with no specific boundaries between Xingguans）。本文件不提供星官边界多边形。
